Interactive P15 Coronal Atlas (DeMBA)

A real coronal slice through the DeMBA P15 volume, with the adult Allen CCFv3 ontology (MOp, MOs, RSP, down to cortical layers) non-linearly registered onto this age's brain shape. These boundaries are computationally warped from the adult atlas, not independently re-annotated at P15 — treat them as a well-informed estimate, not ground truth. Drag the divider to compare STPT template vs diagram; hover or click any region for its full name.
